subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘CURSOR’ is written as ‘564’ and ‘BOY’ is written as ‘126’. How will ‘FREE’ be written as in that language?
solution: The alphabets and their positions are: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a2074f2af1444ff647bcff61bf4a768c4f4d9fb9ab69389563894deb3580edad.png] The logic here is: (Sum of the place values of the alphabets) × Number of letters in the word For ‘CURSOR’ is written as ‘564’
